reported_segments.name: Launch Services
reported_segments.business_reality: Electron/HASTE launch and launch-related services; Neutron is a development-stage future option.

reported_segments.name: Space Systems
reported_segments.business_reality: Spacecraft components, spacecraft manufacturing, optical systems, spacecraft design and on-orbit management.

geography.treatment: Use as billing-location disclosure, not as primary demand driver.

revenue_drivers.primary_driver: launch cadence x average revenue per mission
observable_kpis: annual launch count from sourced launch manifest
revenue_drivers.source_status: segment revenue disclosed; annual launch count and ASP not in financial-data pack

revenue_drivers.primary_driver: contract awards and backlog conversion to delivery milestones
revenue_drivers.source_status: product/service revenue and recognition model disclosed; order intake by product unavailable
company-level backlog disclosed; segment split unavailable

margin_drivers.driver: segment mix plus execution cost curve
margin_drivers.model_treatment: model Launch Services and Space Systems gross margins separately
margin_drivers.evidence: Launch gross margin improved to 40.8% in FY2025; Space Systems gross margin improved to 31.3%

margin_drivers.model_treatment: keep R&D as explicit investment line; do not force near-term operating leverage without source
margin_drivers.evidence: R&D was $270.7m in FY2025 vs gross profit of $207.2m

margin_drivers.driver: milestone billing, customer advances, contract assets/liabilities and inventory build
margin_drivers.model_treatment: forecast contract assets/liabilities and inventory as explicit operating working-capital lines
margin_drivers.evidence: contract liabilities were $195.4m at Dec. 31, 2025; customer advances received/billed net were $160.9m in FY2025

base_case_modules: Launch Services revenue and gross profit
Space Systems product revenue and gross profit
Space Systems services revenue and gross profit
scenario_modules: government customer concentration and program delays
do_not_do: Do not allocate company-level backlog to segments without source.
Do not model RKLB as one consolidated revenue CAGR.
Do not treat launch complex theoretical capacity as base-case launch volume.
Do not count Neutron as current historical Launch Services run-rate.

valuation_methods.use: Test implied backlog conversion, Launch/Space Systems margins, R&D fade and Neutron scenario.
Separate Launch access / Neutron option from Space Systems project/components business.
Use at least two peer lenses: launch/infrastructure and aerospace/space systems components; do not rely on one peer set.
